suppress.notes: False positive. CVE-2026-42582 is for io.netty:netty-codec-http3 (QPACK literal unbounded allocation in HTTP/3 header decoding). The core Netty 4.1.x modules (netty-buffer, netty-codec, netty-handler, etc.) do not include HTTP/3 support. Same-vendor cross-module over-match, pinned to the CVE and suppressed indefinitely: the advisory is permanently scoped to netty-codec-http3, so the core modules can never become a true positive for it. Added: 2026-05-20

False positive. CVE-2026-56816 (GHSA-hpcc-26xq-25fv, HIGH) is memory exhaustion via HTTP/3 reserved frame types, scoped to io.netty:netty-codec-http3 < 4.2.16.Final. netty-codec-http3 is not on any classpath here: the flagged jars are the core Netty 4.1.136.Final modules (netty-buffer, netty-codec, netty-codec-http, netty-codec-http2, netty-common, netty-handler, netty-resolver, netty-transport, netty-transport-classes-epoll, netty-transport-native-unix-common), which arrive transitively via software.amazon.awssdk:v2-migration -> netty-nio-client on the compileClasspath / provided configurations and do not include HTTP/3 support. Same-vendor cross-module over-match, identical in shape to CVE-2026-42582 above; pinned to the CVE and suppressed indefinitely (permanently http3-scoped, so the core 4.1.x modules can never become a true positive for this CVE). Added: 2026-08-03
